lines.zh: 我在海底的沙上慢慢爬
lines.en: I crawl slowly over the seafloor sand

lines.zh: 背上的小叶子一晃一晃
lines.en: The little leaves on my back sway as I go
The water is warm and my pace is lazy

lines.zh: 我贴着海底的岩石过去
lines.en: I pass close along the rocks on the seafloor

lines.zh: 两对小角在水里显得很小
lines.en: My two pairs of small horns look tiny in the water

lines.zh: 软软的身子，走过留下一道痕
lines.en: My soft body leaves a trail in the sand

lines.zh: 阳光从水面透下来，斑斑点点
lines.en: Sunlight filters down from the surface in patches
I do not swim, I crawl

lines.zh: 珊瑚的影子罩住我半天
lines.en: A coral shadow covers me for a long while
I work my way down a gentle slope

lines.zh: 水一动，我的叶子也跟着动
lines.en: When the water stirs, my leaves move with it
I move slower than the seaweed
Fine sand all the way, easy going

lines.zh: 我从一丛海草旁边爬过
lines.en: I crawl past a clump of seagrass

lines.zh: 水有点凉，我躲到石头后
lines.en: The water is cool, I shelter behind a stone
Two steps, then a pause

lines.zh: 我贴在石头上，像一团青绿
lines.en: I cling to the stone like a clump of green
The leaves on my back rock slowly
The seafloor is quiet, only water moving

lines.zh: 我张开小角晒水里的光
lines.en: I spread my small horns to the underwater light
The warm shallows are comfortable

lines.zh: 我一动不动，蟹都爬过来了
lines.en: I stay still and a crab crawls over
Sand drifts past me

lines.zh: 身上有一点黏，那是我的办法
lines.en: I am a little slimy, that is my way
I tuck into a small clump
Light is shifting on the surface

lines.zh: 不需要躲，我本来就像植物
lines.en: No need to hide, I already look like a plant

lines.zh: 我慢慢地吸收周围的东西
lines.en: I slowly take in what is around me

lines.zh: 沙粒一阵一阵从身边过
lines.en: Grains of sand pass by me in waves

lines.zh: 我把背上的叶子理了理
lines.en: I tidy the leaves on my back

lines.zh: 你在水里，比我大太多了
lines.en: You are in the water, and far too large
I lift my head, my small horns toward you
Do not grab me, I am too soft
I edge toward the coral

lines.zh: 我的背是绿的，底下是白的
lines.en: My back is green, my underside white

lines.zh: 我不认得你这样的东西
lines.en: I do not know what manner of thing you are

lines.zh: 水流把我的味道带过去了
lines.en: The current carries my scent to you
Come closer and I will curl up

lines.zh: 海底的动物里，我算慢的
lines.en: Among seafloor creatures I am one of the slowest

lines.zh: 你的影子让这一片暗了
lines.en: Your shadow has darkened this patch
I am not a fish, do not expect me to swim
I only eat what is beside me
There is a layer of water between us

lines.zh: 你踩下来，整片沙都浑了
lines.en: When you step down, all the sand clouds up

lines.zh: 我把背上的小叶全贴紧了。
lines.en: I press every little leaf on my back down flat.
Even something soft as me can ache
A leaf came off
I roll half a turn and stop
A tear in my side
I slowly pull myself in
After that I hid for a long while
A little slime seeped out
I press to the stone and dare not move
The seafloor is dangerous

lines.zh: 你手里那点东西，在水里飘
lines.en: What is in your hand drifts in the water
I reach out a horn and touch it
What I eat does not come from you
It drifted away, I do not chase
I am slippery, I cannot hold things

lines.zh: 这味道在暖水里散得很快
lines.en: This smell spreads fast in warm water

lines.zh: 我伸长软软的头，碰了碰它。
lines.en: I stretch my soft head out and nudge it.
Lower it, I cannot reach

lines.zh: 我不太会分辨能吃不能吃
lines.en: I am not good at telling what can be eaten
A little taste is enough
I open my mouth slowly, it is tiny

lines.zh: 暖水里什么都飘，我分不清
lines.en: Everything drifts in warm water, I cannot tell

lines.zh: 你要是放下，我就慢慢来
lines.en: If you set it down, I will come slowly

lines.zh: 我不着急，海底的东西都慢
lines.en: I am in no hurry, things on the seafloor are slow
Your touch rolled me half a turn
A soft body does not hurt from bumps, it just tilts

lines.zh: 你脚下踩的是沙，我差点被埋
lines.en: You stepped on sand and nearly buried me
I curl, then spread out again
Do not crowd me, I am against a stone
You have muddied the water

lines.zh: 我飘起来一小段，又落下
lines.en: I float a short way, then settle

lines.zh: 这一撞，我的叶子掉了一片
lines.en: That knock cost me a leaf
I have no hard shell like others

lines.zh: 轻一点，海底的东西都软
lines.en: Gently, everything down here is soft
My kind does not do that
I am content alone on the seafloor

lines.zh: 柔柔软软的，也没谁来找我
lines.en: Soft as I am, nobody comes looking

lines.zh: 暖水里同类的味道很少
lines.en: Few scents of my kind in the warm water
I have no reply to that
The seagrass sways, so do I
I have never considered this
Stand there if you will

lines.zh: 我只想找个安静的地方吃
lines.en: I only want a quiet place to feed
Time passes slowly on the seafloor
A small piece landed on the sand

lines.zh: 我用软软的头碰了一下
lines.en: I touch it with my soft head
It stuck to me
I push, and it moves not at all
This does not look edible
I slowly cover it
Covered with sand, it is lost
I taste it, the flavor is odd
I balance it on a horn
It fell here, it belongs to this sand
The current changed
I lift my head and see a shadow
I cling to the stone without moving
This thing stays close by
I squeeze into a gap in the coral
Something this slow cannot run
I squeeze my body into the rock's seam
The green on me might be enough

lines.zh: 它动的时候，水也跟着动
lines.en: When it moves, the water moves too
I watch, and do not move
It is still somewhere near
I crawl slowly toward the seagrass
Sand flows around me
When I move, the water muddies

lines.zh: 这个速度，它随时能跟上
lines.en: At this speed it can follow at will

lines.zh: 我干脆装成石头上的东西
lines.en: I may as well pass as something on the rock
The light dimmed, good

lines.zh: 我把身子压进沙里，只露出背。
lines.en: I press myself into the sand until only my back shows.
Its shadow has not gone

lines.zh: 我慢慢吐掉一口水，不出声。
lines.en: I let out a slow mouthful of water, making no sound.
I butt with a horn

lines.zh: 这力气，大概只有一点点
lines.en: This force is perhaps a very little

lines.zh: 我摊开身子，轻轻推了你一下。
lines.en: I spread my soft body and give you a gentle shove.
Soft against hard, and I lose
I cannot even bite down
Pressing down does nothing either
I bump once and roll away
There is slime on you now
Done striking, I go back to crawling
This much can only be called a push

lines.zh: 暖水的海底多了个青绿的团
lines.en: A green lump has joined the warm shallows
I come up out of the sand
A few little leaves on my back are swaying
There is a new shadow by the seagrass
I spread my body out slowly
The water stirred, and I was there

lines.zh: 这里的沙很细，适合待着
lines.en: The sand here is fine, good for staying
Light reaches me through the water

lines.zh: 一丛珊瑚底下，我停下了
lines.en: I stop beneath a clump of coral
I have come out to feed

lines.zh: 热水扑过来，我缩得很快
lines.en: Hot water washed over me and I curled fast
I dropped off the rock into the sand

lines.zh: 我在水里，可这不是我的水
lines.en: I am in water, but not the right water
The shockwave pushed me far

lines.zh: 一支箭从水面上下来，擦到我
lines.en: An arrow came down through the water and grazed me

lines.zh: 一股陌生的力气钻进我身子里
lines.en: A strange force got into my body

lines.zh: 这一片海底没什么可吃的
lines.en: There is nothing to eat on this patch of seafloor

lines.zh: 雷打在水面上，整片海都在震
lines.en: Lightning hit the surface and the whole sea shook

lines.zh: 这里没有水，我的身子发干
lines.en: There is no water here, my body is drying out
